name: Tianmi meimo zhi jia
source:
A recently laid-off musician picks up a girl on the street—turns out she’s a succubus!? To make ends meet, they start streaming music together. Rhythm game meets visual novel in a sweet and spicy cohabitation with your new demon roommate!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225060]Steam[/url]]
translation:
剛被裁員的音樂人在街上撿回一個女孩，結果她竟是魅魔？！為了餬口，兩人開始一起直播音樂演出。節奏遊戲遇上視覺小說，和新來的惡魔室友一起過上又甜又辣的同居生活吧！

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225060]Steam[/url]］
